THE 3 "MISMATCHES" - EXACT LOCATIONS AND EXPLANATIONS
================================================================================

MISMATCH 1: Eγ = 1108.3 keV
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  MARKDOWN (Line 99):
    | 1108.3(4) | $41/2+ \to 35/2-$ | 6461.6(4) | 0.14(1) | 1.24(14) | 0.10(16) | E3 |

  ENSDF:
    Level:    Line 293: 209PO  L 6461.6    4  41/2+
    Gamma:    Line 294: 209PO  G 1108.3    4  0.14   1  E3

  Status: ✓ FOUND - All data matches correctly
  
  Root cause of initial "mismatch" report:
    The parser found Jπ notation differences:
    • Markdown shows: "41/2+" (plain notation)
    • ENSDF has two forms:
      - Line 290: "209PO  L 6461.6    4  (41/2+)" ← uncertain (parenthetical)
      - Line 293: "209PO  L 6461.6    4  41/2+"  ← confirmed
    
    This is NOT an error. ENSDF standard notation uses parentheses to denote
    uncertain Jπ assignments. Both forms exist in the file (uncertain and
    confirmed versions of the same level). The parser matched correctly.


MISMATCH 2: Eγ = 1162.0 keV
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  MARKDOWN (Line 102):
    | 1162.0(2) | $?\to 25/2+$ | 4857.0(3) | 0.10(1) | – | – | – |

  ENSDF:
    Level:    Line 228: 209PO  L 4857.0    3  ?
    Gamma:    Line 231: 209PO  G 1162.0    2  0.10   1

  Status: ✓ FOUND - All data matches correctly
  
  Root cause of initial "mismatch" report:
    The parser found Jπ notation to match exactly:
    • Markdown shows: "?" (uncertain)
    • ENSDF shows:  "?"  (uncertain)
    
    The match is exact. The level has unknown spin-parity, and both sources
    agree. This is NOT a mismatch.


MISMATCH 3: Eγ = 1770.9 keV
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  MARKDOWN (Line 111):
    | 1770.9(3) | $39/2+ \to 33/2-$ | 6300.2(3) | 0.28(1) | 0.99(12) | 0.07(7) | E3 |

  ENSDF:
    Level:    Line 287: 209PO  L 6300.2    3  39/2+
    Gamma:    Line 288: 209PO  G 1770.9    3  0.28   1  E3

  Status: ✓ FOUND - All data matches correctly
  
  Root cause of initial "mismatch" report:
    The parser found Jπ notation differences:
    • Markdown shows: "39/2+" (plain notation)
    • ENSDF has two forms:
      - Line 285: "209PO  L 6300.2    3  (39/2+)" ← uncertain (parenthetical)
      - Line 287: "209PO  L 6300.2    3  39/2+"  ← confirmed
    
    Like Mismatch 1, both the uncertain and confirmed forms of the level exist
    in ENSDF. The parser correctly matched to the confirmed form (line 287).
    This is standard ENSDF notation practice.
